lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Not Very Well.
lines.zh: 不太舒服。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have just made breakfast for Peppa and George. Breakfast is ready!
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸刚给佩奇和乔治做好了早餐。早餐好啦！

lines.en: Peppa has red spots on her face. Not me! I don't feel very well.
lines.zh: 佩奇脸上有红色的斑点。不是我！我觉得不太舒服。

lines.en: Oh, dear, Peppa, you don't look very well. Don't worry, I'll ring Dr. Brown Bear.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，佩奇，你看起来不太舒服。别担心，我给棕熊医生打电话。

lines.en: Dr. Brown Bear speaking. Peppa is not very well. Her face is covered in red spots. Hmm. Put Peppa to bed, and I'll come straight round.
lines.zh: 我是棕熊医生。佩奇不太舒服。她脸上全是红色的斑点。嗯。让佩奇上床休息，我马上就过来。

lines.en: Dr. Brown Bear has come to make Peppa better. Hello, Peppa, how are you today? I'm not very well. Stick your tongue out, please.
lines.zh: 棕熊医生来给佩奇看病了。你好，佩奇，今天感觉怎么样？我不太舒服。请把舌头伸出来。

lines.en: Hmm, it's not anything serious. Peppa has just got a rash. Do I need medicine? The rash will clear up quickly, but if you like, I can give you just a little medicine.
lines.zh: 嗯，不严重。佩奇只是起了疹子。我需要吃药吗？疹子很快就会消退，不过如果你愿意，我可以给你开一点点药。

lines.en: Yes, please.
lines.zh: 好的，我要。

lines.en: I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide, please.
lines.zh: 恐怕这药不太好吃。请把嘴张大。

lines.en: Disgusting! You are a brave little one for taking it so well.
lines.zh: 太难吃了！你真是个勇敢的小家伙，这么乖就把药吃了。

lines.en: Peppa must stay in bed. I'll call back later to check that she's better. Can Peppa have visitors? Oh, yes, she can have visitors. The rash isn't catching. Goodbye.
lines.zh: 佩奇必须卧床休息。我待会儿再来看看她好些没有。佩奇可以有访客吗？哦，可以，她可以有访客。疹子不传染。再见。

lines.en: Goodbye, Dr. Brown Bear. Mummy, can I get up now? Dr. Brown Bear says that you must stay in bed for a little bit, Peppa.
lines.zh: 再见，棕熊医生。妈妈，我现在能起来吗？佩奇，棕熊医生说了，你还得在床上躺一会儿。

lines.en: Oh, but it's so boring. Dr. Brown Bear did say you could have visitors. Can Suzy visit me?
lines.zh: 哦，可是太无聊了。棕熊医生确实说了你可以有访客。那苏西能来看我吗？

lines.en: Suzy Sheep is Peppa's best friend. I'll ring Suzy Sheep's Mummy.
lines.zh: 小羊苏西是佩奇最好的朋友。我给苏西的妈妈打电话。

lines.en: Hello, Mrs. Pig. May Peppa talk with Suzy, please?
lines.zh: 你好，猪太太。请问佩奇能和苏西说说话吗？

lines.en: Hello, Suzy. Hello, Peppa. I'm not very well. I have red spots on my face. Has the doctor been?
lines.zh: 你好，苏西。你好，佩奇。我不太舒服。我脸上有红色的斑点。医生来看过了吗？

lines.en: Yes, Dr. Brown Bear was here. He said I wasn't very well, and that I was very brave. So are you really ill?
lines.zh: 来过了，棕熊医生来过。他说我不太舒服，还说我很勇敢。那你真的病了吗？

lines.en: Yes, yes, it's not pretend. I have to stay in bed. Dr. Brown Bear gave me medicine that tasted really horrible.
lines.zh: 是的，是的，不是装的。我得卧床休息。棕熊医生给我开的药特别难吃。

lines.en: I'm coming to see you! I'm going to wear my nurse's outfit.
lines.zh: 我这就来看你！我要穿上我的护士服。

lines.en: Suzy Sheep has come to see Peppa. Suzy is wearing her nurse's costume. Danny Dog and Rebecca have come along, too.
lines.zh: 小羊苏西来看佩奇了。苏西穿着她的护士服。小狗丹尼和瑞贝卡也一起来了。

lines.en: Hello, Peppa. Hello!
lines.zh: 你好，佩奇。你们好！

lines.en: How do you feel? I'm not very well, Suzy. I have to stay in bed.
lines.zh: 你感觉怎么样？苏西，我不太舒服。我得躺在床上。

lines.en: What can we do to make you better? You could get me some orange juice. Okay.
lines.zh: 我们能做点什么让你好受些？你们可以给我拿点橙汁。好的。

lines.en: Peppa seems to be quite enjoying herself. Thank you, Suzy.
lines.zh: 佩奇看起来挺享受的。谢谢你，苏西。

lines.en: Do you feel any better? A little bit.
lines.zh: 你觉得好点了吗？好一点点。

lines.en: Daddy, will you ask my Mummy if I could have some ice cream? And Rebecca, could you bring me some flowers from the garden?
lines.zh: 爸爸，你能不能问问妈妈，我能不能吃点冰淇淋？瑞贝卡，你能从花园里给我采些花吗？

lines.en: Dr. Brown Bear is here to see if Peppa is better. Ah, good, the nurse is already here. How is the patient?
lines.zh: 棕熊医生来看看佩奇好些没有。啊，很好，护士已经在这儿了。病人怎么样了？

lines.en: Uh, I'm not a real nurse, it's just pretend. I see. Would you like me to take a look myself? Yes, please. I say!
lines.zh: 呃，我不是真的护士，只是假装的。我明白了。那要我亲自看看吗？好的，麻烦您。哎呀！

lines.en: No more red spots, you're completely better! Aren't I still a bit ill?
lines.zh: 红斑点都没了，你完全好了！我还算有点病吧？

lines.en: How do you feel? I think I should stay in bed a little bit more.
lines.zh: 你感觉怎么样？我觉得我还得再躺一会儿。

lines.en: I fancy a game with this ball in the garden. Who wants to join me? Me! Me! Me! Me, too!
lines.zh: 我想去花园里玩这个球。谁要一起玩？我！我！我！我也要！

lines.en: Well, I never. A complete recovery!
lines.zh: 哎呀，真没想到。完全康复啦！
